brand_identity.name: Red Pot Kitchen
brand_identity.target_audience: Students and everyday consumers in Philippines

usage.display: Used for massive background text (SOLO, DOUBLE) and main 'BIRRIA BOMB' title. Uppercase only.
usage.heading: Used for section titles, navigation links, and product names.
usage.body: Used for descriptions, prices, and about text.

usage_rules.primary: CTAs, 'RED POT' logo text, 'BIRRIA BOMB' underline, accents.
usage_rules.text: Use #FFEBE6 for body text to reduce eye strain. Use #FFFFFF for headings and high-contrast elements.

sections.name: Navigation
sections.style: Glassmorphism or Solid #2C2C2C on scroll. Transparent initially.

sections.name: Hero
sections.content: Centered MP4 Logo + 'BIRRIA BOMB' text with underline.

sections.name: Order
features: Huge background text (SOLO, DOUBLE) with low opacity

sections.name: About
sections.style: Minimal, centered or asymmetric text block describing the brand story.

buttons.style: Sharp edges or slightly rounded (rounded-sm). Solid Brand Red background, White text.

cards.style: No visible card borders for products. Let them float on the background. Use negative space.

navigation.active_state: Underline animation (framer-motion layoutId) in Brand Red.

animations.scroll_reveal: Fade up + Scale up for product images.
animations.parallax: Background text (SOLO/DOUBLE) moves slower than foreground content.
animations.hover: Scale 1.05 for buttons, underline growth for links.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Install 'framer-motion' and 'lucide-react' if not present.
2. TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js with the specific brand colors (brand-bg, brand-red, etc.).
3. FONTS: Add the Google Fonts link to the index.html or import in CSS.
4. STRUCTURE: Create a single page component (e.g., LandingPage.js) that contains all sections.
5. HERO: Ensure the video loops, mutes, and plays inline (playsinline attribute).
6. PRODUCTS: Implement the 'Huge Background Text' effect. This can be done by placing a large absolute positioned text behind the relative product image.
7. MODAL: Create a reusable 'OrderModal' component using Shadcn Dialog. It should accept an 'isOpen' state.
8. RESPONSIVE: Ensure the huge background text doesn't break mobile layout (scale it down using vw units).
9. NAVIGATION: Implement smooth scrolling to section IDs (#home, #order, #about).
10. TESTING: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (nav links, buy buttons, modal close).
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients. Stick to the flat #2C2C2C background.
Ensure text contrast is high. Use #FFFFFF for critical info.
Use 'Anton' font for the 'SOLO' and 'DOUBLE' background text to match the 'Bebas Neue' style request.
Keep the footer extremely minimal (Copyright only).
The 'Buy Now' buttons should both open the same modal with a placeholder iframe.
